text: なにか　わからない　ときは　いつでも　どこでも　ヘルプ！

structure.jp: なにか　わからない　ときは
structure.en: when there is something you don't understand

structure.jp: いつでも　どこでも　ヘルプ！

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.explanation: A verb phrase placed right before とき 'time' tells you which time, so it reads as 'when ...'. なにか　わからない　とき = 'when you don't understand something'.
